caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a painted and decorated exterior. The chest has a dark green upper section that features panels with ornamental designs and folk-art motifs. On the front, there are three main panels: the central panel contains a yellow heart-shaped motif with the text "HENRICH SCHMIDT 1792" written inside, while the panels on either side display symmetrical floral patterns with stylized red flowers and green leaves on a yellow background. The two side panels of the chest repeat the floral motif. The lower section of the chest is reddish-brown and contains three drawers with metal handles and escutcheons, and the chest stands on four bracket feet with curved profiles. The chest's lid has green coloring with a border detail and the overall composition is rendered with attention to detail, giving emphasis to the colors and decorative patterns. The artist’s name “Betty Jean Davis” appears in small letters to the left of the chest.
title: Pa. German Chest
